core_conflicts: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.

The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.

Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.

Thrown into the castle's subterranean wet cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium and frame her for witchcraft, Juliana breaks down in isolation before swearing that they will never take Alexander from her.

When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.

segments.segment_role: Lost Son's Crest & Pounding at Door

candidates.hook_description: The dying Dowager Duchess gasps in shock as she spots Juliana's wedding band and clamps her wrist: 'Do not move! Where did you get this ring?!'
candidates.cliffhanger_description: The Duchess weeps: 'That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest. My lost son wore that exact ring! What is your husband's name?' just as guards pound on the door.
candidates.standalone_context: A mistreated 'maid' curing the dying Duchess discovers her humble soldier husband gave her the royal family's lost signet ring.
candidates.why_it_works: Pure dramatic irony that hooks viewers on the emotional mother-in-law recognition beat and cuts right before Alexander's name can be spoken.
